mechanism_narrative: MET (RTK) and IL6ST (gp130, cytokine receptor) are both expressed in aged MuSC and myofibers. The exposit_rigid linker forces MET's tyrosine kinase domain into proximity with IL6ST's JAK-associated intracellular domain, enabling transphosphorylation of shared adaptor docking sites. This amplifies GRB2-SHC1-GAB1-PIK3R1-PTPN11 signaling (MAPK/ERK + PI3K/AKT + STAT3) while sterically excluding PLCγ and FRS adaptors that require specific receptor-specific docking geometries. The biased output shifts muscle toward a young transcriptional program: upregulating contractile/structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) via SRF/MRTF downstream of MAPK, and downregulating aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) via AKT-mediated FOXO inactivation and STAT3-mediated SOCS3 feedback.
